description: This file defines the AppDatabase class which is a Room database for local data persistence in an Android app. It includes entity declarations and DAO access methods.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: An abstract class extending RoomDatabase that serves as the main access point to the persisted database. It provides DAOs for NoteEntity and SyncStateEntity.

methods.name: create
methods.description: A static method to instantiate the AppDatabase, configure it with destructive migration fallback, and build the Room database instance.
